newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - May 29.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - May 29.

text.p: The following is the berthing schedule for major dry bulk vessels unloading at Taiwan's main grain ports at Taichung and Kaohsiung, as detailed on Thursday by Taiwanese surveyors:
The discharging cargoes are given in tonnes. Berthing dates
are for arrival in port/expected completion of discharge.
